name: Voxel Fragment Shader Rendering
definition: A fragment shader that renders voxels as solid cubes by performing ray-AABB intersection in screen space, computing normals, sampling colors, and applying fog.
summary: Voxel Fragment Shader Rendering is a fragment-shader-based technique that renders voxels as solid cubes by performing ray-AABB intersection in screen space, moving geometric logic from the CPU to the per-fragment pipeline.
